results.content:
by: Ford McCracken, The Hill

Posted: Nov 13, 2026 / 11:19 AM CST

Updated: Nov 13, 2026 / 11:20 AM CST

(The Hill) – President Trump’s job approval rating sits at a second-term low in a new post-election survey, showing little sign of improvement after his party suffered widespread losses in the midterms.

In the new Economist/YouGov poll, 63 percent of Americans said they disapproved of Trump’s job performance, including 52 percent who disapproved strongly, with just 32 percent approving. [...] The Economist/YouGov survey was conducted among 1,685 U.S. citizens from Nov. 9 to 11. Its margin of error is plus or minus 3 points.
